dedupe_keys.name: water quality data from s can sensors in the barcelona sewer system

description: BCASA and s::can publish sewer water-quality sensor observations from three Barcelona neighbourhoods. Zenodo provides a CSV free under CC BY 4.0. Instruments in Poblenou, Sant Gervasi and Carmel record physicochemical conditions for sewer operation, including the potential to study odour, corrosion, sediment blockage or unusual discharges. These measurements can calibrate water-quality and asset-maintenance components of sewer simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this SCOREwater installation. Coverage is three locations with undisclosed exact positions to prevent vandalism, not a full city network survey. The landing page does not enumerate measured variables, units or observation period; a timestamped filename alone is not a verified temporal range. Inferring neighbourhood behaviour from sewer chemistry also needs external validation. No CSV was downloaded or contamination event confirmed.
